Hi Avi — copying finance ops notes so we're all aligned.

Quick answers:
- Our AP system uses PO number as the primary key by default. For multi-location cases we can accept a separate "site_code" column and map PO+site_code as the compound key if you prefer. If you send the CSV with both PO and site_code columns we'll map site_code to the invoice routing field.
- Micro-deposit process for ACH verification: we will post two micro-deposits (less than $0.50 each) to the account you provided. Once those appear, confirm the amounts back to jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com and we'll flip the vendor to active. Expected timeline: deposits in 1-2 business days after DocuSign is complete.
- Wires: for same-day wires we require the bank letter with intermediary routing and a point-of-contact (on the bank letter) for tracing. Your attached letter looks fine but if the intermediary info is not included please send it.

Marissa — when Avi confirms the micro-deposits, can you please enable PO routing and add Sunridge as "segmented remittance" in the vendor profile?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Finance Systems
